blurb: Tidewater RV Park offers affordable RV sites, RV spaces, and RV lots for rent in Hoodsport on scenic Hood Canal. We specialize in monthly and long-term RV living, with extended stay and permanent RV space options available in a quiet, pet-friendly RV park open year-round.Our full hookup RV sites include water, sewer, and power, making them ideal for comfortable, simple living.
